title: Neural Network Components
summary: This module implements core neural network layers and operations, focusing on recurrent mechanisms and gated delta networks for efficient model execution and state management.

nodes.label: GatedDeltaNet.Forward
nodes.title: GatedDeltaNet Forward Pass
nodes.description: Executes the forward pass of the GatedDeltaNet, processing input tensors through various linear projections, convolutions, and recurrent gated delta operations to produce an output tensor.

nodes.label: TestGatedDeltaDelegatesToKernel
nodes.title: Gated Delta Kernel Delegation Test
nodes.description: Verifies that the GatedDelta wrapper correctly delegates its operations to the underlying optimized MLX FastGatedDelta kernel, ensuring functional parity and correctness.

nodes.label: Recurrent Cache Management
nodes.title: Recurrent Cache Management
nodes.description: Manages the recurrent state and history for neural network operations, including snapshotting and retrieval of past states to maintain conversational context.

nodes.label: MLX Core Operations
nodes.title: MLX Core Operations
nodes.description: Provides fundamental MLX library functions for tensor manipulation, mathematical operations, and neural network primitives like convolutions and normalizations.

groups.label: Core Neural Network Logic
groups.title: Core Neural Network Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the primary forward pass implementation for the GatedDeltaNet, handling input transformations and recurrent state updates.

groups.label: Testing and Validation
groups.title: Testing and Validation
groups.description: Contains unit tests to ensure the correctness and proper delegation of neural network kernel operations.
